string.name: addon_remote_initial
string.value: Confirm the server address, then select Load list.

string.name: addon_remote_origin_unknown
string.value: Could not determine the HTTP(S) server. Enter its address and port.

string.name: addon_remote_changed
string.value: Server changed. Check the address and credentials again.

string.name: addon_remote_empty
string.value: No manual or motion-triggered recordings are available.

string.name: addon_remote_cached
string.value: Recording cached. Use the playback controls to watch.

string.name: addon_remote_choose
string.value: Choose where to export the recording.

string.name: addon_remote_failed
string.value: Could not finish. Check that the recording is still available, your account has access, the device has free space and the format is supported.

string.name: addon_remote_trust
string.value: Connects only to the specified server. Use HTTPS when possible. HTTP sends your username and password in cleartext.

string.name: addon_remote_play_failed
string.value: This device cannot play the recording. Try exporting it instead.

string.name: addon_remote_count
string.value: Recordings: %d. Select a file to play or export.

string.name: addon_remote_bad_origin
string.value: Enter an HTTP(S) server address without credentials, a path or a query string.

string.name: addon_remote_denied
string.value: Access denied. Check the username and password.

string.name: addon_remote_limit
string.value: Too many recordings in the list.

string.name: addon_remote_length
string.value: The response exceeds the allowed length.

string.name: addon_remote_changed_response
string.value: The response is too large or the file has changed.

string.name: addon_remote_connection
string.value: Connection failed or a redirect was refused.

string.name: addon_remote_cache
string.value: Could not cache the response. Check available storage.

string.name: addon_remote_list_failed
string.value: Could not load the list. Check the server address, connection and credentials.
